pages.text:
Regular Meeting Notice
                   Truckee-Donner Recreation and Park District Board of Directors
                              Thursday, October 22, 2026, 4:00 P.M.
                  Steve Randall Community Recreation Center, 10981 Truckee Way

The Board of Directors welcomes you to its meeting. Your interest is encouraged and appreciated.
Copies of the agenda and correspondence may be obtained at the District office.

1. OPEN MEETING

2. ROLL CALL

3. PUBLIC COMMENT - This is the opportunity for members of the public to address the board on any
matter not on the agenda. Please state your name for the record. Comments are limited to three minutes
in order for all interested parties to have an opportunity to speak. No action shall be taken by the board
on items not appearing on the agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2 – Brown Act). The board may
choose to acknowledge the comment or, where appropriate, briefly answer a question, refer the matter to
staff, or set the item for discussion at a future meeting.


     Agenda Item Process – The board will follow the process below on each agenda item:
     1. Item is presented by staff or applicant.
     2. Questions from the board to the staff or applicant.
     3. Public comment – Limited to three minutes.
     4. Discussion by Board.
     5. Board action (if action needs to be taken).

4. CLOSED SESSION
    4.1 Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4) - Deciding whether to initiate litigation, one case
5. PRESENTATIONS
    5.1 Introduction of New Employees
    5.2 Potential Downtown Assessment District
    5.3 Scholarship Program
    5.4 Appreciation of Outgoing Board Members

6. NEW BUSINESS
   6.1 Discussion / Possible Action Adopting a new Policy #247 – Boundaries for Employees and
   Volunteers Interacting with Minors
   6.2 Discussion / Possible Action Adopting a new Policy #248 – Bereavement Leave and Reproductive
   Loss Leave
   6.3 Discussion / Possible Action Updating the District Wage Schedule for FY 2026-2027


 10981 Truckee Way, Truckee, California 96161 | Phone: (530) 582-7720 | Fax: (530) 582-7724 | www.tdrpd.org

6.4 Discussion / Possible Action Adopting Resolution #2026-363 Authorizing Signatories for CalOES
         Cybersecurity Grant

7. CONSENT CALENDAR
     7.1 Approval of the minutes of the special Board meeting of August 13, 2026
     7.2 Approval of the minutes of the regular Board meeting of September 24, 2026
     7.3 Approval of the District check registers for September 3, 17, and 30, 2026
     7.4 Adoption of an update to Policy #206 – Sick Leave
     7.5 Adoption of an update to Policy #306 - Reserve Fund Policy

8. FINANCIAL REPORT

9. DIVISION REPORTS
     9.1 Park Division Update
     9.2 Recreation Division Update
     9.3 Marketing Update
     9.4 Accounting & Office Division Update
     9.5 Information Technology Division Update
     9.6 Human Resources Division Update
     9.7 General Manager’s Update

10. BOARD COMMITTEE REPORTS
     10.1 Budget and Finance Committee (Wasley & Hansford)
     10.2 Facility Condition Assessment Committee (Tanner & Marquette)
     10.3 Truckee Recreation & Park Foundation Liaison (Smith)

11. CLOSED SESSION
     11.1 Government Code Section 54956.8 – Conference with Real Property Negotiators. Property:
          Nevada County Assessor’s Parcel Numbers: 019-441-004-000 and 019-450-077-000. Agency
          Negotiators: Sven Leff (General Manager) and Jason Hansford (Board member). Under
          Negotiation: Price and Terms.
     11.2 Government Code Section 54957 - Public Employee Performance Evaluation: General Manager

12. ADDITIONAL MATTERS OF INTEREST TO BOARD MEMBERS
         Board members may make a brief announcement or report

13. ADJOURN

Agenda posted and mailed on October 16, 2026

___________________________________
David Faris, HR Manager/District Clerk
NOTE: In compliance with the American with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please
contact David Faris, District Clerk, at 530-582-7720. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable TDRPD to make
reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting. (28 CFR 35.102-35.104 ADA Title II)
